verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs confirm that Identity Verification checks and validates name, date of birth, ID numbers, and addresses (plaid-idv-docs-1, plaid-idv-docs-12), implying extraction of these fields, but no evidence explicitly shows the API returning these as structured retrievable fields (e.g., a documented response schema with document number, expiry, address, DOB) rather than risk/pass-fail indicators shown only in the Dashboard (plaid-idv-docs-11, plaid-idv-docs-20). Missing for 10: explicit API response/schema documentation exposing extracted document fields, and independent/hands-on confirmation of structured field retrieval.
